# Production-Readiness Checklist: Library Manager API

**Purpose**: Reviewer-owned requirements-quality gate for production-readiness across architecture, correctness, security, cache/Outbox, observability, tests, and delivery docs.
**Created**: 2026-08-25
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [constitution](../../../.specify/memory/constitution.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Architecture & Nomenclature

- [ ] CHK001 Are Clean Architecture dependency rules specified for each project (Domain inward-only; Application limited to Domain and framework-neutral abstractions; Infrastructure vs Api ownership; no Generic Repository)? [Completeness, Constitution II, Plan §Architecture and Runtime Design]
- [ ] CHK002 Is English-only nomenclature required for source, namespaces, database objects, Docker/Kubernetes names, logs, tests, Git names, and the mandated `LibraryManager.*` project names? [Completeness, Constitution I, Plan §Project Structure]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the absence of CQRS, Command/Query/Handler, `IRequest`/`IRequestHandler`, mediator, and MediatR terminology an explicit, testable requirement? [Clarity, Spec §FR-064, Constitution II, Plan §Summary]

## Concurrency, Idempotency & Audit

- [ ] CHK004 Do requirements define last-copy lending outcomes (one success, one rejection, one loan, AvailableCopies = 0, never negative) across multiple API instances? [Completeness, Spec §FR-023, Spec §FR-024, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK005 Is PostgreSQL specified as the only inventory concurrency control, via atomic conditional update, with process memory, `SemaphoreSlim`, application locks, and Redis locks forbidden? [Clarity, Constitution III, Plan §Create loan transaction]
- [ ] CHK006 Are TotalCopies updates specified so they cannot fall below borrowed copies while racing with loans, and so AvailableCopies cannot go negative? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009, Plan §TotalCopies updates]
- [ ] CHK007 Is `POST /loans` idempotency specified as durable PostgreSQL uniqueness on Endpoint + Key, with SHA-256 of a defined canonical request? [Completeness, Spec §FR-026, Spec §FR-029, Plan §Idempotency]
- [ ] CHK008 Are same-key same-hash replay as HTTP 201 with stored body, same-key different-hash HTTP 409 only, concurrent single-owner semantics, and rollback of ownership on unexpected failure specified without treating business-rule failures as 409? [Consistency, Spec §FR-027, Spec §FR-028, Spec §FR-029, Spec §FR-060, Spec §FR-065, Spec §SC-003, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK009 Is AuditEvent required to persist in the same PostgreSQL transaction as the corresponding successful mutation, and forbidden as a success record when the mutation fails? [Completeness, Spec §FR-030, Spec §FR-031, Constitution III]
- [ ] CHK010 Are AuditEvent fields (entity type, id, action, actor, UTC time, correlation id, jsonb context) fully specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-030, Data model §AuditEvent]

## Security & Identity

- [ ] CHK011 Are JWT Bearer validation requirements complete for signature, issuer, audience, and lifetime, with Authority and Audience externalized? [Completeness, Spec §FR-034, Spec §FR-036, Spec §FR-041, Plan §Authentication and Keycloak]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the API specified as a resource server that never accepts username/password and never issues JWTs? [Clarity, Spec §FR-035, Constitution Security]
- [ ] CHK013 Are local Keycloak requirements complete (versioned image, realm `library-manager`, importable realm file, audience `library-manager-api`, Swagger client `library-manager-swagger`)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-039, Spec Clarifications, Plan §Authentication and Keycloak]
- [ ] CHK014 Is Swagger authentication specified as Authorization Code with PKCE, with an explicit local redirect URI and no wildcard redirects when avoidable? [Clarity, Spec §FR-040, Plan §Authentication and Keycloak]
- [ ] CHK015 Are the librarian role, flat `roles` claim, and Librarian policy for mutations and GET `/audit-events` specified consistently, with other reads authenticated and health anonymous? [Consistency, Spec §FR-037, Spec §FR-050, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK016 Are HTTP 401 (missing/invalid authentication) and HTTP 403 (authenticated without required role) specified as distinct, non-interchangeable mutation outcomes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-038, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK017 Is authenticated actor identity specified as JWT `sub` via `ICurrentUserContext` only, with Domain User remaining a separate borrower (`UserId`) and Application forbidden from `HttpContext`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012, Spec §FR-032, Spec §FR-058, Constitution Security]

## Cache & Transactional Outbox

- [ ] CHK018 Is Redis specified as a non-authoritative cache of `GET /books/{id}/availability` only, never consulted when deciding whether a loan can succeed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-025, Spec §FR-042, Plan §Summary]
- [ ] CHK019 Are cache key, bounded TTL, immediate post-commit async invalidation, metric/log on failure, and a ban on `Task.Run` fire-and-forget all specified without conflict? [Consistency, Spec §FR-043, Spec §FR-044, Constitution Cache, Plan §Constraints]
- [ ] CHK020 Must availability-changing transactions write a durable Outbox message in the same DbContext transaction as the business mutation (FR-043 as the FR-046 instance for availability, including post-commit Redis invalidation)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-043, Spec §FR-046, Spec §FR-061, Plan §Create loan transaction]
- [ ] CHK021 Are Outbox records specified as Infrastructure (not Domain), written via an Application abstraction? [Consistency, Spec §FR-061, Spec §FR-063, Data model §OutboxMessage]
- [ ] CHK022 Is Outbox claiming specified as a database-backed lease (`FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`, `LockedBy`, `LockedUntilUtc`) committed before Redis I/O? [Clarity, Spec §FR-047, Plan §Outbox processor]
- [ ] CHK023 Are crashed-worker lease expiry, retry metadata (`AttemptCount`, `NextAttemptAtUtc`, `LastError`), and `ProcessedAtUtc` on success specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-047, Data model §OutboxMessage]
- [ ] CHK024 Are multi-replica Outbox processing, at-least-once delivery, and idempotent consumers (duplicate invalidation is safe) specified together? [Coverage, Spec §FR-045, Spec §FR-047, Plan §Multi-replica correctness]
- [ ] CHK025 Is a rationale documented for why 2–11 API replicas remain correct (stateless API, PostgreSQL inventory/idempotency, transactional audit/Outbox, leases, Redis not authoritative)? [Completeness, Plan §Multi-replica correctness, Spec §FR-055]

## Observability & Health

- [ ] CHK026 Is `X-Correlation-ID` specified to preserve a valid incoming value or generate one, return it, and propagate it through logs, traces, and AuditEvents via `ICorrelationContext`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-033, Plan §Correlation and observability]
- [ ] CHK027 Are OpenTelemetry-compatible traces and metrics required, including the named loan, idempotency, cache-invalidation, and Outbox instruments, with UTC timestamps? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015, Spec §FR-048, Spec §FR-049, Plan §Correlation and observability]
- [ ] CHK028 Are liveness and readiness distinguished (`GET /health/live` process-only HTTP 200 vs `GET /health/ready` PostgreSQL and Redis, HTTP 503 when a dependency is down), both anonymous? [Completeness, Spec §FR-050, Plan §Health]

## Tests, Delivery & Documentation

- [ ] CHK029 Are integration tests required to use real PostgreSQL via Testcontainers for persistence, last-copy including two API hosts sharing one database, idempotency, and Outbox guarantees, with CancellationToken on public async APIs? [Completeness, Spec §FR-024, Spec §FR-052, Spec §FR-066, Plan §Testing]
- [ ] CHK030 Are integration tests required to use real Redis via Testcontainers for cache hit/miss, invalidation, and related Outbox processing? [Completeness, Spec §FR-052, Quickstart §Automated tests]
- [ ] CHK031 Are authentication/authorization integration scenarios specified (401, 403, librarian success, audit actor) with any test auth scheme limited to the test host? [Coverage, Spec §FR-052, Plan §Testing]
- [ ] CHK032 Does Docker Compose have a complete required service set (API, PostgreSQL, Redis, Keycloak 26.7.2 with realm import) and English service names? [Completeness, Spec §FR-053, Plan §Compose and Kubernetes]
- [ ] CHK033 Are Kubernetes baseline artifacts specified (Deployment, Service, ConfigMap, Secret references, CPU/memory requests and limits, liveness and readiness probes) with Keycloak excluded from those manifests? [Completeness, Spec §FR-054, Plan §Compose and Kubernetes]
- [ ] CHK034 Is production secret handling specified (no production credentials in source control or the Keycloak realm file; appsettings plus environment or secret providers; K8s Secret references)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-041, Spec §FR-056, Plan §Constraints]
- [ ] CHK035 Must the README be entirely English and document execution, authentication, migrations, tests, architecture, concurrency, idempotency, audit, caching, Outbox, observability, and multi-replica correctness? [Completeness, Spec §FR-055, Quickstart §README]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
- Clarifying questions were skipped: the request already listed the production-readiness domains, audience (reviewer gate), and depth (production-readiness)
